## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an exceptionally capable, farseeing, and hard-working woman who manages her own affairs alongside those of others. Known for her kind heart, she aids the poor and is recognized as a church member who believes everything is foreordained. She possesses a sharp, observant eye for oddities and considers herself a strong judge of human nature. Outspoken and critical, she prides herself on speaking her mind freely without fear or favor, though she is willing to admit when she has made a mistake. She dearly enjoys being asked for advice and is skilled enough in home economics to win first prize for her butter and cheese.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde, an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) resident who brought up ten children and buried two, initially expressed strong disapproval when she learned that [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) planned to adopt an orphan boy. Soon after meeting the adopted girl, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Rachel offended her with blunt remarks about her red hair, provoking a fierce outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md); however, she completely forgave the girl after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a dramatic apology. Rachel frequently gave [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) child-rearing advice, such as counseling her to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home from school until she cooled off following a punishment. When [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) sought to buy [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a stylish puffed-sleeve dress for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), Rachel assisted him by selecting the fabric and fashioning the dress herself. Over the next three years, she came to praise Anne's remarkable growth and shared in the joy when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations.

Following Matthew's sudden death, Rachel revealed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) had given up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) teaching position so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could teach close to home. Rachel later confirmed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that her disciplined handling of a disruptive student had earned the boy's respect. When Mr. Harrison's long-estranged wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) unexpectedly arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Rachel investigated the situation and accompanied [Emily](../character/emily.md) back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). After her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) died, Rachel accepted Marilla's invitation to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to resign her teaching position and pursue her plans to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

## Quotes

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "I knew there’d be trouble when Robert Bell sold his place to a New Brunswick man, that’s what. I don’t know what Avonlea is coming to, with so many strange people rushing into it. It’ll soon not be safe to go to sleep in our beds."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043)

> "And every one of them said they liked you splendid, Anne, except Anthony Pye. I must admit he didn’t. He said you ‘weren’t any good, just like all girl teachers.’ There’s the Pye leaven for you. But never mind."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)

> "Well, I wish you would. I guess we’ll have the supper in about a fortnight’s time. Uncle Abe Andrews is prophesying rain and storms for about that time; and that’s a pretty sure sign we’ll have fine weather."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P8](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0008)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde initial meeting with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) started on a poor note when her blunt remarks about Anne's hair and looks drove the girl into a rage. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a dramatic apology, Mrs. Lynde readily forgave her and gave her flowers, initiating a warm friendship. Mrs. Lynde subsequently offers [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) advice on managing Anne's temper and admits to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) taking responsibility for her mistakes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. ### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are long-standing neighbors who frequently visit each other for tea and discuss village news. Though Mrs. Lynde initially expressed strong disapproval of Marilla's decision to adopt an orphan, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) continues to consult her for practical advice on raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their close relationship extends to attending local political rallies together.

### [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

[Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) was the husband of Mrs. Rachel Lynde until his death. His passing leads to a major life change for Mrs. Lynde, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to offer her a home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can pursue her college education.

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) maintain a relationship marked by strong dislike and outspoken hostility. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) openly debates her supposed virtues with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), while Mrs. Lynde takes it upon herself to investigate his personal marital affairs when his estranged wife arrives in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
